sloka: सर्वभोगैः परित्यक्तं स्वर्गच्युतमिवामरम् ।दृष्ट्वा तु करुणा पूर्वं ममासीत् समितिञ्जय ।। ६.१२७.६ ।।
transliteration: sarvabhogaiḥ parityaktaṁ svargacyutamivāmaram ।dṛṣṭvā tu karuṇā pūrvaṁ mamāsīt samitiñjaya ।। 6.127.6 ।।

translations.english: "Rama! You, who are victorious in winning enemies, have earlier on account of father's words, intent on following father's words, accepting Kaikeyi's words, went with Lakshmana and Sita, clad in bark clothes, giving up kingdom and all possessions, like heaven set out on foot and entered huge forest, living on roots and fruits of the forest. Seeing you, compassion arose in me."
translations.hindi: हे महाबाहो ! तुमने मुके जैता समझ रका है, में वैसी नहीं हूँ । इस विषय .में तुम! मेरे ऊपर विश्वास रक्खो । में अपने. < वातिब्रत घर्म की शपथ खा कर यह्‌ बात तुमसे कहती हू
